# InTune® Stick + Hiba Wood (New 2026)

**Category:** Personal Care

**Type:** Portable Topical Focus Stick

---

## Short Description

👑 New Fall 2026 release from doTERRA's Global Convention — a mess-free, travel-friendly topical stick combining the newly reformulated **InTune® Focus Blend** with **Hiba Wood**
👑 Features the upgraded 13-oil CPTG® InTune formula (including Rosemary, Peppermint, Copaiba, Wild Orange, and Spanish Sage) paired with grounding Japanese Hiba Wood
👑 Easy glide-on application with no spills — ideal for work desks, backpacks, and travel

## Directions for Use

🔹 Apply topically to the temples, back of the neck, or wrists when studying, working, or needing steady focus

## Precautions

> ⚠️ For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Avoid eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Keep out of reach of children.
